title: UI Interaction by @wekodek: designers, this is for you: you can finally leave feedback on the impl
notes:
designers, this is for you: you can finally leave feedback on the implementation of your design right on the website. same figma-style comments, but on the real product, in the browser, with toolbar. and devs, you’re not left out. any feedback or reported issues, you can now submit them to Claude Code, who will resolve them independently using our MCP. designers get pixels. devs get autopilot.

Designer: @wekodek. Curated on Collect UI (https://collectui.com).
